1.why: Pure guess among percents; 18 and 9 read like raw head-counts rather than percents (18 of 60 = 30%), so 30 is the option the count-distractors point at.

2.why: 5 is out of range for a median next to 12/13/14 (looks like the number of rows). Among 12/13/14, 13 is the centre and the value an even-count average would give.

3.why: Power of a point: PT^2 = PA*PB, 36 = 4*PB, PB = 9, AB = 9 - 4 = 5. Options 9 (=PB) and 13 (=PA+PB) are the standard slips.

4.why: 60 and 28 look like the two bar heights themselves; their difference 32 is an option, and 16 is half of it. Answer chosen as the difference of the two plausible raw readings.

5.why: Four-month total; 850/900/1000 are round decoys spaced 50-100 apart. 1050 is the least round and the only value not obtainable by dropping one month from another option.

6.why: cos C = adjacent/hypotenuse = BC/AC = 8/10 = 4/5. 4/3 and 5/4 exceed 1 so are impossible for a cosine; 3/5 is sin C.

8.why: sqrt(8^2 + 15^2) = 17. Also 17 is the only option >= 15, the minimum possible distance given the y-gap.

9.why: f(x) = a(x+1)(x-3); vertex value -4a = -8 gives a = 2, so f(0) = 2(1)(-3) = -6.

10.why: 5/2 > 1 is impossible for a probability. 24/100 uses the grand total as denominator (classic wrong-denominator distractor), implying the correct value is 24/60 = 2/5.

11.why: 21 = 3 x 7 looks like a total-for-3-tickets decoy, which makes 7 the per-ticket value it was built from.

12.why: sqrt(15^2 - 12^2) = sqrt(81) = 9; 9-12-15 triple. sqrt39 and 3sqrt11 come from adding instead of subtracting or mis-squaring.

13.why: Half-chord 12, radius 13, distance = sqrt(169-144) = 5. 12 is the half-chord, 1 is 13-12.

14.why: sqrt(20^2 + 21^2) = sqrt(841) = 29. 841 is the un-square-rooted value, 41 is the sum of legs, 21 a single leg.

15.why: tan C = opposite/adjacent = AB/BC = 12/16 = 3/4. 4/5 and 3/5 are sine/cosine values.

16.why: Guess. 25/30/60 plausibly are the readings at neighbouring times; 45 sits between 30 and 60 as the t=3 value on a rising curve.

17.why: Geometric mean relation: BD = sqrt(AD*DC) = sqrt(16) = 4. 10 is the whole hypotenuse.

19.why: sqrt(29^2 - 21^2) = sqrt(400) = 20. Also 8 and 9 are impossible: a leg that short cannot pair with 21 to make 29 (21+8=29 is degenerate).

20.why: Options form the doubling chain 26/52/104/208, the signature of halve/double time errors. 52 is the interior value most such chains are centred on (e.g. 104 miles in 2 hours).

21.why: Guess among four legal probabilities; 2/3 and 16/25 are suspiciously clean/large for a two-way-table conditional, leaving 4/15 and 5/12. Picked 5/12.

22.why: Inscribed angle = half the central angle = 50 degrees. 100 is the central angle restated.

23.why: 4/11 has a denominator that cannot be an untreated-row subtotal shared with the others; 7/10 is high for a control group. Picked 2/5 over 1/5 as the more typical control flowering rate.

24.why: Inscribed angle = 120/2 = 60 degrees. 120 restates the central angle.
